// captureCss: iPhone chrome drawn in the frame (3:3 status bar, 3:66 home indicator): the app gets them as safe-area insets. The home indicator is drawn over the tab bar by the OS, so it is emulated here too; the status bar band is not compared.
captureCss: :root { --safe-top: 44px; --safe-bottom: 25px; } html::after { content: ''; position: fixed; z-index: 10; left: 50%; bottom: 8px; width: 134px; height: 5px; margin-left: -67px; border-radius: 2.5px; background: #101828; }
